# Odhra

> India's premium multi-vendor marketplace. Discover curated collections from 500+ verified vendors with secure payments and fast pan-India delivery.

Odhra is a curated marketplace connecting shoppers with verified premium brands across fashion, lifestyle, and home categories. The platform supports flash sales, loyalty rewards, and vendor storefronts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured collections, flash sales, and trending products.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse all products with filters by category, price, and vendor.
- [Flash Sales](/flash-sales): Time-bound deals and promotions.
- [About](/about): Our story, mission, and vendor program.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach customer support.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about orders, shipping, and returns.

## Optional

- [Install App](/install): Install Odhra as a Progressive Web App.
- [Spin to Win](/spin-to-win): Daily rewards mini-game for signed-in users.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
